description:
Create a schema proposal against a source variant, the same action as Create proposal in GraphOS Studio.
GraphOS creates a proposal variant that starts as a copy of the source variant's schema, and the proposal starts in DRAFT.
Returns the proposal variant's name and the new proposal's ID and status, or an error with a message.
To add schema changes, call PublishProposalRevision next.
Provide the graph ID, the title, and the source variant name.
Optionally provide a description.
name: CreateProposal
